title: Botania x Tensura: Reincarnated Compatibility
description: Adds compatibility between Botania and Tensura: Reincarnated
body: I made the EP higher for the Gaia Guardian, Pixie and Pink Wither and gave them skills and resistances. Gaia Guardian and Pink Wither count for the race evolutions with Boss Kills required. Added EP to all Botania weapons and tools.
